high_relevance_finds.paper: Autonomous Market Intelligence: Agentic AI Nowcasting Predicts Stock Returns
high_relevance_finds.signal: 100% agentic LLM evaluates Russell 1000 stocks daily via autonomous web search. Top-20 ranked stocks: 18.4 bps/day alpha (FF5+MOM), Sharpe 2.43 annualized. Data starts April 2025. Highly concentrated at top tier.
high_relevance_finds.relevance: DIRECT blueprint for H210. Confirms feasibility and provides exact methodology. If we replicate top 17% of our 30-stock universe (top-5), Sharpe 2.43 is possible.
high_relevance_finds.priority: HIGH — raises H210 from speculative to evidence-backed

high_relevance_finds.paper: AlphaCrafter: A Full-Stack Multi-Agent Framework for Cross-Sectional Quantitative Trading
high_relevance_finds.signal: Three-agent pipeline: Miner (factor pool expansion), Screener (regime-conditioned ensemble selection), Trader (risk-constrained execution). Daily rotation. Factor mining is adaptive/ongoing, not one-time.
high_relevance_finds.relevance: Direct implementation of H209. Architecture is more specific than our original spec. Key improvement: regime-conditioned factor blending (Screener agent) fits perfectly with our confirmed strategies.
high_relevance_finds.priority: HIGH — AlphaCrafter is H209 done; study before implementing

high_relevance_finds.paper: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
high_relevance_finds.signal: Structural features of 8-K press releases (guidance section presence, non-GAAP table emphasis, forward-looking word ratio) predict announcement-day returns beyond FinBERT sentiment score alone. Dataset: 138k press releases 2005-2023.
high_relevance_finds.relevance: Additive enhancement to H174 (FinBERT 8-K pipeline). Low-risk 3rd filter gate on top of existing dual-threshold system.

high_relevance_finds.paper: SAE-FiRE: Enhancing Earnings Surprise Predictions Through Sparse Autoencoder Feature Selection
high_relevance_finds.signal: Sparse Autoencoder for Financial Representation Enhancement — denoises earnings call features by selecting only predictive components. Addresses signal/noise separation problem in earnings call analysis.
high_relevance_finds.relevance: Longer-term upgrade for H174 — would require significant implementation. Not staged yet; monitor for a follow-up paper with code release.

high_relevance_finds.paper: Building Cross-Sectional Systematic Strategies By Learning to Rank
high_relevance_finds.signal: LambdaRank/LightGBM Ranker on cross-sectional factors yields ~3x Sharpe vs traditional ranking. Direct to H211 quality-filtered universe design.
high_relevance_finds.relevance: H211 implementation method: use LGBMRanker with per-stock rolling IC as a quality weight. Better than hard IC cutoff.

medium_relevance_finds.paper: Enhancing Post Earnings Announcement Drift Measurement with Large Language Models
medium_relevance_finds.signal: FinBERT achieves 57.6%/58.3% classification accuracy on PEAD measurement — validates H174's use of FinBERT domain-specific model over general LLMs.

medium_relevance_finds.paper: ATLAS: Adaptive Trading with LLM AgentS (arXiv:2510.15949)
medium_relevance_finds.signal: Unified multi-agent framework handling late/obscured reward signals in trading — addresses the 'noise-obscured reward' problem for RL-based agents.
medium_relevance_finds.note: Relevant if we pursue H204 (PPO RL); not for H209/H210

medium_relevance_finds.signal: Calibrates LLM trading behavior through controlled backtesting in high-noise market environments (2024 Q1, 2026 Q1). Selective consensus reduces decision uncertainty.
medium_relevance_finds.note: Could apply to H210 ensemble design: use multiple LLM rankings + consensus

low_relevance_finds.paper: Language Model Guided Reinforcement Learning in Quantitative Trading (arXiv:2508.02366)
low_relevance_finds.note: RL + LLM combo — relevant only if H204 (deep RL) is prioritized

github_finds.note: S&P 500 + STOXX 600 cross-sectional momentum with skewness enhancement; TSM+CSM combo. Validation that our H198 approach is well-established.
Multi-factor model with AI/LLM integration and backtesting. Stars unclear but architecture similar to H209 target.

summary: Strong session. Two HIGH-priority finds: arXiv:2601.11958 provides the exact implementation blueprint for H210 (Sharpe 2.43 published result validates the approach), and arXiv:2605.05580 (AlphaCrafter) is essentially H209 already published — we should read it before implementing. The PEAD structural features paper (2509.24254) is a clean incremental improvement to H174 with low implementation risk. H211 gets the learning-to-rank framework from 2012.07149 as an implementation method. 4 proposals staged total.
